name: io.github.nuoframework/darktrace-mcp
title: Darktrace Threat Visualizer (unofficial)
description: Hardened local stdio MCP server for the Darktrace Threat Visualizer API (unofficial).

environmentVariables.name: DARKTRACE_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS origin of the Darktrace appliance, for example https://darktrace.example.internal

environmentVariables.name: DARKTRACE_PUBLIC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Darktrace API public token (or set DARKTRACE_PUBLIC_TOKEN_FILE to an owner-only file)

environmentVariables.name: DARKTRACE_PRIVATE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Darktrace API private token (or set DARKTRACE_PRIVATE_TOKEN_FILE to an owner-only file)

environmentVariables.name: DARKTRACE_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Capability profiles: read (default), sensitive, write, critical or all, comma separated. all, or sensitive with write, also needs DARKTRACE_ACKNOWLEDGE_SENSITIVE_WRITE=true

environmentVariables.name: DARKTRACE_ACKNOWLEDGE_SENSITIVE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true only to run all, or a profile list with both sensitive and write; the server refuses to start that combination without it. Sensitive results are untrusted content and write free-text fields can carry them out: an exfiltration risk
